title.narrative: Creation of Permanent Institutional Framework for Regulatory Impact Assessment

description.narrative: Assistance is requested to ensure the transformation of the existing Secretariat of the Council for Regulatory Reform from a temporary into a permanent unit within the General Secretariat of the Government. Considering that regulatory reform should not be regarded as a one-time measure, but as a continuous process, the overall objective of the project is to ensure long-term sustainability of Regulatory Impact Assessment (RIA) and administrative burdens reduction at the level of the Government of Serbia. RIA was introduced in Serbia as mandatory in 2004 providing that for each new law, and other regulatory instruments such as decrees and orders, the responsible ministry will prepare a justification statement containing the analysis of a set of questions developed in accordance with the OECD RIA recommendations and the Secretariat was empowered to perform the function of coordination and quality control of the RIA'a prepared by the relevant Ministries. A draft law can reach the government agenda only if it is accompanied by an opinion of the Secretariat in relation to the RIA performed. So far, the Secretariat has analyzed and given opinions on over 200 laws and established itself as an important step in securing the quality of new laws, either through advisory role or actively participating in the preparation of legislation. TF096222 The grant will support the Government of Serbia in transforming the Secretariat of the Council for Regulatory Reform from a temporary unit into a permanent one within the government structure, thus ensuring long-term sustainability of ex-ante and ex-post Regulatory Impact Assessment (RIA) and Administrative Burdens Reduction (ABR) on the national level.
